Table
This column is typically used in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint for additional
event information in other tables. In Microsoft Defender XDR, you can get
related data directly from the AlertEvidence  table.
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint queries will work as-is unless they reference the
DeviceAlertEvents  table. To use these queries in Microsoft Defender XDR, apply these changes:
Replace DeviceAlertEvents  with AlertInfo .
Join the AlertInfo  and the AlertEvidence  tables on AlertId  to get equivalent data.
